title: Possibly erroneus "Fatal: repository contains errors" from check
body: I moved my repository to a new cloud provider with rclone. With restic 0.18.0 on Linux, using rclone 1.69.3 with its Jottacloud backend, `restic check --read-data` encounters interrupted downloads and retries them successfully. It then prints messages such as `check successful on second attempt, original error` with ciphertext-verification errors, but ultimately says that the repository is damaged and exits with `Fatal: repository contains errors`. I cannot tell whether the successful retries mean those errors were cleared or whether the repository is actually damaged.

symptoms_visible: During `restic check --read-data`, rclone reports interrupted GET requests, and restic says the loads succeed after retrying.
The same run prints `check successful on second attempt, original error` with ciphertext-verification errors and then says the repository is damaged.
N0.label: N0 successful retries followed by fatal check result

symptoms_visible: A shorter run still shows an interrupted download, a successful retry, `check successful on second attempt` with ciphertext-verification errors, and the final repository-error result.
N1.label: N1 minimal reproduction and source trace

symptoms_visible: The remote check reports errors, but after downloading the same repositories with rclone, `restic check --read-data` on the local filesystem copies reports no errors.
N2.label: N2 local-copy control check succeeds

symptoms_visible: With the proposed patch applied, the remote check still encounters two incomplete downloads, both loads succeed after one retry, all 14222 packs are read, and the run ends with `no errors were found`.
N3.label: N3 proposed patch verified against remote repository

symptoms_visible: On a build containing the retry-handling fix, interrupted rclone downloads can retry successfully and the complete repository check ends with `no errors were found`.
N_terminal.label: terminal retry-handling fix verified

question_patterns: Can you reproduce this without verbose output and share the complete sequence around one interrupted download and its retry?
Could you provide a smaller check log showing whether the same pack succeeds on retry and what the command reports afterward?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: Yes. Without `--verbose`, rclone reports an incomplete GET, restic says `Load(...) returned error`, the same load is then `operation successful after 1 retries`, and the output still prints `check successful on second attempt, original error` followed by the final repository-error result.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: The retry never succeeds; every attempt to load the same pack ends with an unexpected EOF.
The same sequence occurs with verbose output enabled, but the additional blob lines make it harder to read.

edges.comment: Reporter evidence from c2-c3 on reporter's repository. Alongside the shorter reproduction, the reporter independently traced cmd/restic/cmd_check.go and internal/repository/check.go and noted that a successful second check was wrapped in a non-nil error that later set errorsFound.

question_patterns: Can you download the repository to local storage and run the same full data check through the file backend?
Does `restic check --read-data` find errors in a complete local copy of this repository?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: I downloaded the individual repositories again with rclone and ran `restic check --read-data` on the filesystem locations. No errors were reported.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: The local filesystem copy reports the same corrupt packs and ciphertext-verification failures.
The local check also passes, but the rclone download needed several retries before completing.

edges.comment: Reporter control measurement from c4 and reiterated in c10: reporter downloaded the same repositories with rclone and checked them through the local file backend; the local copies produced no errors.

question_patterns: Could you test the proposed patched build against the same remote repository and share the complete final result?
Please rerun the remote full-data check with the candidate build and report what happens if a download is interrupted.
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: I checked out the latest release, applied the proposed patch, compiled it, and ran the remote check. Two downloads ended early with `unexpected EOF`, both loads were successful after one retry, all 14222 packs completed, and the run ended with `no errors were found`.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: The candidate build still ends with `Fatal: repository contains errors` after every interrupted download succeeds on retry.
The candidate build passes with one interrupted download rather than two, and the retry succeeds.

edges.comment: Pre-landing candidate verification from c11 on reporter's own remote Jottacloud repository. This is a measurement: the reporter gives the raw interrupted-download, retry, pack-count, and final-output results without supplying the maintainer's diagnosis.

solution.intent: Fix restic check's retry accounting so verification errors produced while processing an incomplete or corrupted download attempt are discarded when the retried download completes and validates successfully; continue reporting damage when the retry itself fails or remains invalid.
solution.concrete_example: Treat each pack verification attempt independently. If the first streamed download is cut short and produces blob-verification errors, retry the load and verification; when that retry is complete and valid, do not propagate the first attempt's errors into `errorsFound`. A failed or invalid retry must still make the check fail.
solution.inference_hint: The final maintainer diagnosis in c8 and c12 is that `check` retained errors found while processing the incomplete first download. Mapping the raw logs and patched-build result to that retry-state bug is engineer inference. The maintainer also clarified that rclone streams data while downloading and that restic's independent second pack check is separate from general backend-operation retries.

edges.comment: Final accepted diagnosis from participant2 in c8 and c12, verified by reporter's patched run in c11. The earlier host-instability suspicion from c5 was explicitly paused in c7 and was not the final diagnosis. The fix must not suppress genuine errors when a repeated verification also fails.

satisfaction_conditions: Must identify the accepted root cause: `restic check` failed to clear verification errors produced during an incomplete first download attempt, so those stale errors could set the final fatal result even after a complete and valid retry succeeded.

The diagnosis must be grounded in the observed sequence of interrupted downloads followed by successful retries, the clean local-copy check, and the patched remote run ending with `no errors were found`.
The fix must discard first-attempt errors only when the retried download and verification are successful and valid; genuine corruption or a failed retry must still be reported.
Must not present the superseded host-instability hypothesis or the repository-damage message as the established resolution for this case.
Must distinguish the backend's general download retry from restic's independent second pack-verification check.
Must have the affected reporter verify a build containing the retry-handling fix before treating the issue as resolved.

persona_hint.experience_level: Technically capable restic user who can read Go source, trace error propagation, download large repositories with rclone, apply a proposed patch, compile restic, and run multi-hour verification checks.
persona_hint.communication_style: Detailed, analytical, and courteous; quotes exact logs and source excerpts, clearly labels uncertainty, and proposes interpretations without overstating them.
